change.after:
# Python 3.10 requires a callable; None only disables it on 3.11+.
            ledger._db.set_authorizer(lambda *_: sqlite3.SQLITE_OK)

diagnosis.statement: Python3.10.22 registers the supplied authorizer object without a None-disabling branch, invokes it during authorization, and converts callback errors to SQLITE_DENY. Python3.11 documents None support as new. The test's finally block installed None after inspection, so its later iterdump failed on3.10.

receiving.legacy_model: Only authorizer registration semantics from CPython3.10.22 connection.c; runs on actual local Python3.12.
